svg.title: Inside one SparkRing serving container
svg.desc: Every Spark of a model runs one container of the same image, one tensor-parallel rank, on the host network with its RDMA devices and the checkpoint mounted read-only. vLLM with B12X kernels serves the model; SparkRing's runtime-status plugin reports settings, versions, memory and transport. Collectives of the tensor-parallel and decode-context-parallel groups go to SIRCL ring sessions by default, with NCCL off; images without the SIRCL layer use the prepared transport, RoCEnante for small collectives and NCCL 2.32.3 for larger ones. All of them use the four ConnectX-7 RDMA functions and the cables.
